hotspots.title: Trump administration's environmental rollbacks
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has finalized rules that significantly weaken protections under the Endangered Species Act, allowing development on critical habitats. This move has sparked lawsuits from conservation groups and criticism from environmental advocates.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its polarizing nature, affecting wildlife conservation efforts and sparking moral outrage among environmentalists and legal challenges.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen's legal troubles continue as her conviction for misusing EU funds was upheld, though her ineligibility period was reduced. She has announced her candidacy for the 2027 French presidential election despite the legal challenges.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high-stakes legal and political drama surrounding Le Pen's eligibility and her persistent influence in French politics.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei's regional right-wing alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei is actively strengthening ties with right-wing leaders across Latin America, including a planned visit to support Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign in Brazil. This move has sparked diplomatic tensions with leftist governments in the region.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its geopolitical implications and the ideological alignment of right-wing leaders, which carries a strong moral and political charge.
